title: Forever Faithful | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perfectly positioned for adventure and relaxation, this home grants exclusive access to WaterColor’s premier amenities, including the Beach Club, multiple resort-style pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and picturesque nature trails. Private beach access invites days spent on sugar-white sands, while Camp WaterColor’s lazy river and waterslides provide endless fun for families. After a day of exploration, retreat to the luxurious sleeping quarters, featuring four king suites, a charming bunk room, and a spacious third-floor loft. Whether savoring alfresco meals, unwinding on a breezy porch swing, or paddling across Western Lake, this home promises an unforgettable stay in one of 30A’s most sought-after communities. Tucked in the heart of WaterColor, this stunning three-story retreat blends classic Southern charm with modern coastal luxury. Designed to accommodate up to 12 guests, the five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bathroom home offers an inviting escape with elegant interiors, spacious gathering areas, and thoughtfully curated amenities. The open-concept living space is anchored by a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, a formal dining area, and a cozy great room with plush seating and a 70” TV. Step outside to one of four screened porches or relax by the brand-new private pool, surrounded by lush greenery. A six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring the scenic surroundings effortless.
